scope: QA experiments, not user preference defaults or investment recommendations. Previously exposed data; no untouched final result.
harness: TypeScript 5.9 transpileModule CommonJS ES2022, Node direct invocation of real history GET and pure runValidation

dataset.source: Kraken public spot daily OHLC: XBT/CAD, ETH/CAD and LINK/ETH
dataset.note: Native BTC is Kraken XBT. LINK/CAD is derived as LINK/ETH close × ETH/CAD close on the exact same daily candle timestamp; those separate markets' last trades need not be simultaneous. These are spot reference closes, not Ndax fills or historical order books. Kraken documents a 720-entry recent-history limit including an unfinished bar; this loader conservatively retains at most 719 completed matching dates. No backward pagination, filled gaps, synthetic prices or invented high/low prices. Dates label the exchange's daily candles; they are calendar labels, not Eastern midnight timestamps. Coverage is too short for the proposed multi-year untouched walk-forward study.

forecast.note: Unvalidated empirical scenarios, not a reliable profit forecast. Each earlier completed horizon contributes its joint BTC/ETH/LINK return path; no randomized split, return extrapolation, parameter search or advanced ML. Means are historical sample averages. The 10th percentile is an observed-sample downside scenario, not a loss bound or calibrated probability. Shift and HOLD copy exactly the same starting units. Shift waits one observed day, then changes to the configured allocation with adverse slippage and a fee per leg; HOLD leaves those units unchanged. Monthly samples use calendar-month reviews (28–31 days, with a possible shorter first sample); the stated future horizon uses one calendar month. These isolated recommendation comparisons are separate from the continual replay and must not be summed as portfolio profit.

replay.note: Experimental fixed momentum candidate v1. User inputs are scenario parameters, never optimized; this retrospective comparison is not an untouched test or validated forecast. Both paths start with identical already-owned units: 60% divided equally among BTC/ETH/LINK and the rest CAD, marked on 2024-12-24; no artificial opening fees. HOLD never rebalances. Reviews every seven calendar days from the start; 94 reviews. Rank 60-calendar-day close returns using only data through the prior day. Positive winner receives the risk allocation and the rest stays CAD; otherwise CAD. Ties use BTC, ETH, LINK order. Execute at the NEXT observed daily close after review (delayed close proxy), with 10 bps adverse slippage and 20 bps fee on each sell/buy leg. Trade only on a change of selected target; same target means HOLD with drifting weights, and legs below CAD 0.01 are skipped. Changed targets use post-cost equity for sizing. 33 executed legs; CAD 185808.41 gross turnover. All curve points use identical reference marks after any execution costs, charged once. Drawdown uses those observed daily equity points, not intraday prices. Warm-up dates are excluded from both curves. Latest ranking uses history through 2026-10-11; it is an experimental historical ranking, not a live recommendation. Missing dates fail validation. No historical order books or size-dependent fill model: slippage is an assumption, minimum orders and venue precision are not simulated. Limited observations, especially monthly decisions; no calibrated confidence, expected profit, training or advanced-ML claim. Native BTC is Kraken XBT. LINK/CAD is derived as LINK/ETH close × ETH/CAD close on the exact same daily candle timestamp; those separate markets' last trades need not be simultaneous. These are spot reference closes, not Ndax fills or historical order books. Kraken documents a 720-entry recent-history limit including an unfinished bar; this loader conservatively retains at most 719 completed matching dates. No backward pagination, filled gaps, synthetic prices or invented high/low prices. Dates label the exchange's daily candles; they are calendar labels, not Eastern midnight timestamps. Coverage is too short for the proposed multi-year untouched walk-forward study.

report.note: Frozen candidate and empirical estimator v1. The first 365 observed days precede evaluation; chronological 60-day development folds follow, then the final 180 historical days are reported separately. Training refits the empirical distribution at each review using only labels ending before that review. No hyperparameter optimization. Historical data was previously inspected by the application, so all these results are retrospective, including the final tail; none is an untouched final test. Each row compares a fresh identical equal-basket endowment for one non-overlapping review horizon; row profits cannot be added into a continuous portfolio return. The separate continual replay preserves its original HOLD units. Coverage is the observed fraction inside the prior-sample 10–90% incremental range, not a confidence score. Few monthly decisions and serial market dependence prevent a calibrated skill claim. A separate registered 12-calendar-month forward holdout must finish before its result can be opened. Actual holdings are used only in the latest scenario when supplied, never substituted into historical trial endowments.

prospectiveEvaluationLimitation: Each protocol seals its own future scoring endpoint. Later trials can expose overlapping data; no account-wide untouched-test embargo is implemented. Independent final statistical validation remains unfinished.
